verdict.rationale: A government agency running online tax services could plausibly publish versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only web applications (UTR, UTS) and a desktop QuickFile upload tool; no API, versioning scheme, or deprecation policy is documented, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
